en: I came here with some friends to\ncatch us some BUG POKéMON!\pThey're all itching to get into\nsome POKéMON battles!
Hey! You have POKéMON!\nCome on!\lLet's battle 'em!
No!\nCATERPIE can't hack it!
Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away.\nAnother time, okay?
Yo!\nYou can't jam out if you're a\lPOKéMON TRAINER!
Huh?\nI ran out of POKéMON!
That totally stinks! I'm going to\ncatch some stronger ones!
Hey, wait up!\nWhat's the hurry? Why the rush?
I give!\nYou're good at this!
Sometimes, you can find stuff on\nthe ground.\pI'm looking for the stuff I\ndropped. Can you help me?
I might be little, but I won't like\nit if you go easy on me!
Oh, boo.\nNothing went right.
I lost some of my allowance…
Did you know that POKéMON evolve?
Oh!\nI lost!
BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nThey're a lot of fun!
I was throwing POKé BALLS to\ncatch POKéMON, and I ran out.\pThat's why you can never have too\nmany POKé BALLS.
TRAINER TIPS\pIf your POKéMON are weak and you\nwant to avoid battles, stay away\lfrom grassy areas!
For poison, use ANTIDOTE!\nGet it at POKéMON MARTS!
TRAINER TIPS\pContact PROF. OAK via a PC to\nget your POKéDEX evaluated!
TRAINER TIPS\pYou can't catch a POKéMON that\nbelongs to someone else.\pThrow POKé BALLS only at wild\nPOKéMON to catch them!
TRAINER TIPS\pWeaken POKéMON before attempting\ncapture!\pWhen healthy, they may escape!
LEAVING VIRIDIAN FOREST\nPEWTER CITY AHEAD
